text:
Operation to perform the zonal testing required in the DC132
commingling agreement. The first step was to close the upper M57 zone and perform the single zone M55 well test. The second step was to close the lower M55 zone and open the upper M57 zone to perform the single zone M57 well test. The third step was to open the lower M55 zone and return to commingling production from both zones after conducting the single zone well tests. These activities was completed between February 12th to February 14th.

SS 154 #11 Well was on the SS 154 WG 10 Caisson. It was damaged by Katrina, and P&A'd / removed on 12/19/2007 / site cleared on 6/9/2008. The SS 154 #11 well was TA'd in 1998, so only thing done in 2007/2008 was cut / pull the casings, remove the caisson and do the site
clearance. Century Exploration failed to submit the appropriate paperwork to change the status of this well and has since gone bankrupt.

text: The Mad Dog batch set drilling operations installed 36" conductor and 22" surface casing in Green Canyon Block 782. The batch set wells include MD12, MD15, MD16, MD17 and MD18, respectively.  Batch set operations started on September 25, 2013 and concluded on December 21, 2013 with all of the batch set wells status drilling suspended.  The Mad Dog Spar Rig was used for the batch set operation, no BOPs were used during any part of the batch set since all operations were open water.

text: The GC743 DC321 ST00BP00 well was drilled & completed on January 30th 2014. The M-55 sand and the M54 sand were completed. Both intervals were individually Frac Packed sand control completions.  The completion allows for the isolation of the lower interval from the upper interval through the installed down hole flow control system. When the rig moved off the well, the upper interval DHFC sleeve (M55) was left open and lower interval (M54) DHFC sleeve was left closed.
